choice: Waveshare Bus Servo Adapter (A), SKU 25514

specs.interface: USB Type-C or UART (jumper selected); 5.5x2.1 mm DC jack + screw terminal

notes: (Carried from tier B.) Recommend 2 (one per arm): 7 servos per bus halves sync-read/write cycle time at 1 Mbps, keeps each arm's bus cable short (no 1 m+ TTL run across the torso), isolates faults (one arm's bus short or ID clash does not kill the other), and pairs with one 12 V buck per arm. Board current rating is NOT stated: per-arm worst-case stall is ~23.4 A (3 x 4.2 A + 4 x 2.7 A), so feed servo power from a separate 12 V distribution and use the adapter for data (or verify its power path).
